gbifID.description: Unique GBIF occurrence identifier assigned to each record.

datasetKey.description: Unique dataset identifier linking all records to the same occurrence dataset.

occurrenceID.description: Unique iNaturalist observation URL identifying each recorded Paeonia caucasica occurrence.

kingdom.description: Taxonomic highest rank, uniformly Plantae for every record.

phylum.description: Taxonomic phylum classification for all records, consistently Tracheophyta.

class.description: Taxonomic class of the plant, consistently Magnoliopsida across all records.

order.description: Taxonomic order of the plant, consistently Saxifragales.

family.description: Botanical family of the plant, consistently Paeoniaceae across all records.

genus.description: Taxonomic genus of the recorded plant, consistently Paeonia.

species.description: Scientific name of the recorded plant in each occurrence record.

infraspecificEpithet.description: No subspecies or variety designation provided for any occurrence.

taxonRank.description: Taxonomic rank is consistently recorded as species for all occurrence records.

scientificName.description: Scientific name of the recorded plant species, consistently Paeonia caucas

verbatimScientificName.description: Scientific name of the recorded plant, consistently Paeonia caucasica.

verbatimScientificNameAuthorship.description: Scientific name authorship information is missing for all records in this dataset.

countryCode.description: ISO‑3166‑1 alpha‑2 code of the recording country.

locality.description: Locality information is missing for all records.

stateProvince.description: Administrative region within Russia or Georgia where each occurrence was recorded.

occurrenceStatus.description: Occurrence status always recorded as present for each record.

individualCount.description: Number of individuals observed per occurrence record.

publishingOrgKey.description: Identifier for the organization that published each occurrence record.

decimalLatitude.description: Geographic latitude in decimal degrees for each occurrence record.

decimalLongitude.description: Geographic longitude in decimal degrees for each occurrence record.

coordinateUncertaintyInMeters.description: Spatial uncertainty of occurrence coordinates measured in meters.

coordinatePrecision.description: Coordinate precision data missing for all records.

elevation.description: Recorded altitude of each occurrence site, measured in meters.

elevationAccuracy.description: Elevation accuracy data is unavailable for all records.

depth.description: Depth values are missing for all records.

depthAccuracy.description: Depth accuracy (units unspecified) is missing for all records.

eventDate.description: Date and time of each occurrence record, recorded to the second.

day.description: Day of month when the observation was recorded.

month.description: Month of observation, ranging from February (2) to November (11).

year.description: Observation year of each record, ranging from 2000 to 2026.

taxonKey.description: Uniform taxonomic identifier for Paeonia caucasica occurrence records.

speciesKey.description: Constant species identifier code for Paeonia caucasica records.

basisOfRecord.description: All records are derived from direct human observations of the species.

institutionCode.description: Data source identifier for all records, consistently recorded as iNaturalist.

collectionCode.description: Uniform collection identifier labeling all records as observations.

catalogNumber.description: Unique numeric identifier assigned to each occurrence record.

recordNumber.description: No data recorded for this field across all occurrence entries.

identifiedBy.description: Observer names who recorded the species identification for each occurrence.

dateIdentified.description: Identification timestamp of each occurrence record.

license.description: Creative Commons license applied to each occurrence record, specifying attribution and commercial use permissions.

rightsHolder.description: Names of individuals or entities holding copyright for each occurrence record.

recordedBy.description: Observer names who documented each plant occurrence.

typeStatus.description: Type status information is unavailable for all records.

establishmentMeans.description: Establishment means data not recorded for any occurrence.

lastInterpreted.description: Record last interpretation timestamp in ISO 8601 format.

mediaType.description: Media format of the occurrence record, such as still images or other media types.

issue.description: Data quality issue codes identifying coordinate rounding, continent derivation, and missing taxon ID.

paeonia_caucasica.description: Occurrence records of Paeonia caucasica (2005‑2026) with taxonomic, geographic, temporal, and observer metadata.

description: Contains 1001 occurrence records of a plant species across 2005‑2026 for biodiversity monitoring.
